description.value: El Camino's is a Latin American street food restaurant and cocktail bar on Main Street in Vancouver, serving Mexican and South American-inspired dishes—tacos, ceviche, empanadas, and poutine—alongside craft cocktails and a well-curated local beer list. The kitchen also runs a weekend brunch program with dishes like Huevos Rancheros and Chilaquiles. It is part of a small local hospitality group that also operates The Cascade Room nearby.
